title: Gopuff
bio: American delivery service selling snacks, groceries, drinks and household essentials from its own micro-fulfilment centres.

title: Lime
bio: Electric scooter and bike sharing service available in many cities.

title: CRED
bio: CRED is an Indian app that lets members pay credit card bills, rent and utilities and access rewards and credit products.

title: DEGIRO
bio: DEGIRO is an online broker offering European investors low-cost access to stocks, ETFs, bonds, options and futures on many exchanges.

title: Glovo
bio: Spanish delivery app that brings restaurant meals, groceries and other local store items to customers in Europe, Africa and Asia.

title: Wellfound
bio: Wellfound, formerly AngelList Talent, is a job platform where startups post roles and candidates apply for jobs at early-stage companies.

title: Bluesky
bio: Decentralized social network for short posts built on the open AT Protocol, with customizable feeds and moderation.

title: Chobani
bio: American food company making Greek yogurt, oat milk, coffee creamers and ready-to-drink coffee products.

title: Crypto.com
bio: Crypto trading app with a debit card and exchange.

title: GulfTalent
bio: GulfTalent is an online recruitment platform listing professional jobs in the Gulf countries and connecting employers with experienced candidates.

title: Huel
bio: British company selling nutritionally complete powdered meals, ready-to-drink shakes, hot meals and snack bars, mainly online.

title: KuCoin
bio: Cryptocurrency exchange listing a wide range of coins.

title: Lalamove
bio: Hong Kong-based on-demand delivery app that connects customers with drivers of motorcycles, vans and trucks for same-day deliveries.

title: Ola
bio: Indian ride-hailing app for booking cabs, autos and bikes.
